senses.en: relating to or involving subtraction

example.en: Subtractive color mixing is used in printing.
example.zh: 印刷使用的是减色法。

senses.en: the end of a period of time, especially for a contract, licence, or product

example.en: Check the expiry date on the milk carton.
example.zh: 查看一下牛奶盒上的有效期。

senses.en: the degree to which something bad, such as pain or weather, is serious

example.en: Doctors rated the severity of the injury.
example.zh: 医生评估了伤势的严重程度。

senses.en: harshness or strictness in treatment or manner

example.en: The judge was criticized for the severity of the sentence.
example.zh: 这位法官因判刑过重而受到批评。

senses.en: plainness or lack of decoration

example.en: The room's severity gave it a calm feel.
example.zh: 房间的简朴风格让它显得宁静。

senses.en: the forced separation of people by race or other group characteristics

example.en: Racial segregation was outlawed decades ago.
example.zh: 种族隔离几十年前就被宣布为非法。

senses.en: the separation of one thing from others, e.g. waste sorting

example.en: Waste segregation helps recycling.
example.zh: 垃圾分类有助于回收。

senses.en: the practice of exchanging sexual services for money

example.en: Many countries have laws and support programs concerning prostitution.
example.zh: 许多国家都有关于卖淫的法律和帮扶项目。

senses.en: to be required to pay money or repay a debt to someone

example.en: I owe my sister fifty yuan.
example.zh: 我欠我姐姐五十元。

senses.en: to be indebted to someone or something as the source of a success or quality

example.en: She owes her confidence to years of practice.
example.zh: 她的自信归功于多年的练习。

senses.en: to be morally obliged to give someone something, such as an apology

example.en: He owes you an apology for his rude remark.
example.zh: 他为那句无礼的话应该向你道歉。

senses.en: an agreement in judgment or opinion reached by a group

example.en: The committee reached a consensus on the new budget.
example.zh: 委员会就新预算达成了一致意见。

senses.en: a person who spends time with or accompanies another

example.en: A close companion helped him through the difficult year.
example.zh: 一位亲密同伴帮助他度过了艰难的一年。

senses.en: one of a pair of matching things

example.en: The cookbook has a companion volume on baking.
example.zh: 这本食谱有一本配套的烘焙书。

senses.en: Having a duty to deal with something or being accountable for it.

example.en: She is responsible for training new staff.
example.zh: 她负责培训新员工。

senses.en: Being the cause of something.

example.en: Heavy rain was responsible for the delay.
example.zh: 大雨是延误的原因。

senses.en: Able to be trusted to do what is right.

example.en: We need a responsible person to manage the funds.
example.zh: 我们需要一个可靠的人来管理资金。

senses.en: a careful examination or evaluation of something

example.en: The manager gave the report a careful review.
example.zh: 经理对报告进行了仔细审查。

senses.en: to look at or examine something again; to study something again

example.en: Please review your notes before the exam.
example.zh: 请在考试前复习笔记。

senses.en: a critical article about a book, play, or other work

example.en: The magazine published a review of the play.
example.zh: 杂志发表了对这部戏剧的评论。

senses.en: used to say that something is unlucky, regrettable, or disappointing

example.en: Unfortunately, the train was late again.
example.zh: 不幸的是，火车又晚点了。

senses.en: a spoken or written account of what someone or something is like
senses.zh: 对某人或某事物的口头或书面描述；说明

example.en: She gave a clear description of the missing bag.
example.zh: 她清楚地描述了那个丢失的包。

senses.en: the act of saying or writing what someone or something is like

example.en: The report includes a description of the damage.
example.zh: 报告包含了对损坏情况的描述。

senses.en: a kind or type of person or thing

example.en: They sell tools of every description.
example.zh: 他们出售各种各样的工具。

senses.en: a light, soft shoe worn indoors that you can slip on and off easily

example.en: She changed into her slippers as soon as she got home.
example.zh: 她一到家就换上了拖鞋。

senses.en: to gradually disappear or scatter until gone

example.en: The morning fog dissipated as the sun rose.
example.zh: 太阳升起时，晨雾渐渐消散了。

senses.en: to waste (money, time, or energy) carelessly
senses.zh: 挥霍，浪费（金钱、时间、精力）

example.en: He dissipated his savings on unnecessary luxuries.
example.zh: 他把积蓄挥霍在不必要的奢侈品上。

senses.en: the quality of being similar in appearance, character, or nature

example.en: There is a striking likeness between the twin brothers.
example.zh: 这对孪生兄弟长得非常相像。

senses.en: a picture or portrait of a person or thing

example.en: The painter captured a good likeness of the old man.
example.zh: 画家逼真地画出了老人的肖像。

senses.en: lasting only a short time

example.en: The pain was transient and soon disappeared.
example.zh: 疼痛是短暂的，很快就消失了。

senses.en: a person who stays somewhere for only a short time
senses.zh: 短暂停留的人；流动劳工

example.en: Many transients pass through this town during the summer.
example.zh: 夏天有许多过客经过这个小镇。

senses.en: a heater with pipes that circulate steam or hot water to warm a room

example.en: We turned on the radiator because the room was cold.
example.zh: 房间很冷，我们把暖气片打开了。

senses.en: a device in a car engine that cools the engine with liquid

example.en: The car overheated because of a leak in the radiator.
example.zh: 汽车因散热器漏水而过热了。

senses.en: to join pieces of metal by heating and pressing them together

example.en: The workers welded the steel beams together.
example.zh: 工人们把钢梁焊接在一起。

senses.en: to unite people or things closely together

example.en: Shared hardship welded the team into a strong unit.
example.zh: 共同的困难使这个团队凝聚成一个坚强的集体。

senses.en: a joint made by welding

example.en: The inspector checked every weld on the pipeline.
example.zh: 检查员检查了管道上的每一道焊缝。

senses.en: a male given name

example.en: Harvey is coming to dinner tonight.
example.zh: 哈维今晚要来吃晚饭。

senses.en: (golf) the standard number of strokes expected for a hole or course

example.en: He finished the hole two under par.
example.zh: 他这一洞的成绩比标准杆少两杆。

senses.en: a usual or average level; an equal standard; (finance) the face value of a share or bond
senses.zh: 平均水平，同等标准；票面价值

example.en: His latest work is well below par.
example.zh: 他最近的作品远低于平时水平。

senses.en: (golf) to play a hole in the standard number of strokes

example.en: She parred the final hole to win the tournament.
example.zh: 她以标准杆数完成最后一洞，赢得了比赛。

senses.en: real and clear enough to be noticed or measured; able to be touched
senses.zh: 切实的；有形的；可触摸的

example.en: The training produced tangible improvements in performance.
example.zh: 培训带来了切实的业绩提升。

senses.en: something that has physical existence, especially a physical asset

example.en: The company's tangibles include its factories and equipment.
example.zh: 该公司的有形资产包括其工厂和设备。

senses.en: actively doing things; having a lot to do

example.en: She is busy preparing for the meeting.
example.zh: 她正忙着准备会议。

senses.en: full of activity or traffic

example.en: This street is always busy on weekends.
example.zh: 这条街周末总是很热闹。

senses.en: to keep oneself occupied with something

example.en: He busied himself with cleaning the kitchen.
example.zh: 他忙着打扫厨房。

senses.en: an act of causing someone to die

example.en: The police are investigating the killing of the shop owner.
example.zh: 警方正在调查店主被杀一案。

senses.en: a large amount of money earned quickly

example.en: They made a killing when they sold their house.
example.zh: 他们卖掉房子时赚了一大笔。

senses.en: extremely tiring or difficult

example.en: We had a killing schedule last week.
example.zh: 上周我们的日程排得让人精疲力竭。

senses.en: unfair preference for one person or group over others

example.en: The manager was accused of favoritism in hiring.
example.zh: 这位经理被指在招聘中有偏袒行为。

senses.en: light, quick, repeated sounds, such as raindrops or footsteps

example.en: We listened to the patter of rain on the roof.
example.zh: 我们听着雨点打在屋顶上的嗒嗒声。

senses.en: to make light, rapid, repeated sounds

example.en: Rain pattered against the window all night.
example.zh: 雨点整夜敲打着窗户。

senses.en: fast, glib talk used by salespeople or performers
senses.zh: （推销员等的）顺口溜式台词，喋喋不休的话

example.en: The salesman's patter sounded rehearsed.
example.zh: 推销员的花言巧语听起来像是背熟的。

senses.en: a powerful light at the front of a vehicle such as a car

example.en: He turned on the headlamps as the sky grew dark.
example.zh: 天色渐暗，他打开了前照灯。

senses.en: a light worn on a helmet or head, especially by miners and hikers

example.en: The cavers switched on their headlamps before entering the tunnel.
example.zh: 探洞者在进入隧道前打开了头灯。

senses.en: a poem with fourteen lines and a fixed rhyme scheme

example.en: Shakespeare wrote 154 sonnets.
example.zh: 莎士比亚写了154首十四行诗。

senses.en: human beings in general; persons

example.en: Many people came to the meeting.
example.zh: 许多人来参加了会议。

senses.en: the ordinary citizens of a place, especially as voters

example.en: The people demanded cleaner air.
example.zh: 民众要求更清洁的空气。

senses.en: an ethnic group or nation

example.en: Indigenous peoples have lived here for centuries.
example.zh: 原住民族在这里生活了几个世纪。

senses.en: to fill a place with people; populate

example.en: Settlers peopled the valley.
example.zh: 定居者住进了这个山谷。

senses.en: a movable barrier that closes an opening in a fence, wall, or hedge

example.en: She left the gate open and the dog ran out.
example.zh: 她没关大门，狗跑了出去。

senses.en: an exit or entrance area at an airport that passengers use to board a plane

example.en: Our flight leaves from gate 12.
example.zh: 我们航班的登机口是 12 号。

senses.en: a unit of length equal to one thousand meters

example.en: The school is three kilometers from our house.
example.zh: 学校离我们家三公里。

senses.en: used as the object form of “they” to refer to people or things already mentioned
senses.zh: 他们；她们；它们（用作宾语）

example.en: I called them but no one answered.
example.zh: 我给他们打了电话，但没人接。

senses.en: used to refer to one person whose gender is unknown or not specified
senses.zh: 他/她（用于指性别未知或不指定的人）

example.en: If a student is late, ask them to explain.
example.zh: 如果学生迟到，请让他/她解释。

senses.en: a soft yellow food made from cream, spread on bread or used in cooking

example.en: She spread butter on her toast.
example.zh: 她在吐司上抹了黄油。

senses.en: to spread butter on something

example.en: He buttered the bread before adding cheese.
example.zh: 他先在面包上抹了黄油，然后加了奶酪。

senses.en: used in compounds such as 'peanut butter': a thick spread made from nuts or seeds
senses.zh: 用于 peanut butter 等复合词，指坚果或种子制成的酱

example.en: She put peanut butter on the bread.
example.zh: 她在面包上抹了花生酱。

senses.en: to become or make someone feel tired

example.en: Long meetings tire me quickly.
example.zh: 长时间的会议很快让我感到疲倦。

senses.en: (American spelling; British tyre) a rubber covering around a wheel
senses.zh: 轮胎（美式拼写 tire，英式拼写 tyre）

example.en: I had to change a flat tire by the road.
example.zh: 我不得不在路边换一个瘪了的轮胎。

senses.en: to become bored with something or lose interest in it (usually in the pattern tire of)

example.en: She never tires of talking about her trip.
example.zh: 她对谈论自己的旅行从不感到厌倦。

senses.en: a device that gives light, often by electricity

example.en: She turned on the lamp beside the bed.
example.zh: 她打开了床边的灯。

senses.en: a device that controls the flow of liquid or gas through a pipe by opening or closing

example.en: Turn the valve to shut off the water supply.
example.zh: 转动阀门以关闭供水。

senses.en: a flap in the heart or a vein that allows fluid to flow in only one direction

example.en: The doctor said one of his heart valves is leaking.
example.zh: 医生说他有一个心脏瓣膜渗漏。

senses.en: a short memorable phrase used in advertising or politics

example.en: The company created a new slogan for its ad campaign.
example.zh: 公司为广告宣传想出了一个新口号。

senses.en: genuine and honest; not pretending or deceitful

example.en: She gave a sincere apology for being late.
example.zh: 她为迟到诚恳地道了歉。

senses.en: deeply felt; genuine in emotion

example.en: Please accept my sincere condolences.
example.zh: 请接受我诚挚的哀悼。

senses.en: the act of taking control of a country or people by force

example.en: The Norman conquest changed England forever.
example.zh: 诺曼征服永远地改变了英格兰。

senses.en: success in gaining or achieving something, such as overcoming a difficulty or winning someone's affection
senses.zh: 赢得；克服；（尤指爱情上的）俘虏

example.en: Climbing the mountain was her greatest conquest.
example.zh: 登上那座山是她最大的胜利。

senses.en: a room or space partly or wholly underground, often used for storage

example.en: We keep old wine bottles in the cellar.
example.zh: 我们把旧酒瓶放在地窖里。

senses.en: a sharp sound like a long 's', or a sound showing disapproval

example.en: We heard the hiss of steam escaping from the kettle.
example.zh: 我们听到水壶冒出蒸汽的嘶嘶声。

senses.en: to make a sharp sound like a long 's'; to show disapproval with such a sound

example.en: The audience hissed when the actor forgot his lines.
example.zh: 演员忘词时，观众发出嘘声。

senses.en: a pace faster than walking, like that of a horse or jogger

example.en: The horse moved off at a trot.
example.zh: 那匹马小跑着离开了。

senses.en: to run or move at a moderately fast, steady pace

example.en: She trotted across the field to catch up with her friends.
example.zh: 她小跑着穿过田野去追赶朋友们。

senses.en: to ride or make a horse move at a trot

example.en: She trotted her horse around the arena.
example.zh: 她让马绕着骑马场小跑。

senses.en: strange or unusual, often in an amusing way

example.en: My uncle is an eccentric man who always wears two different socks.
example.zh: 我叔叔是个古怪的人，总是穿着两只不同的袜子。

senses.en: a person who behaves in a strange or unusual way

example.en: The old eccentric was often seen feeding pigeons in the park.
example.zh: 人们常看到那个怪老头在公园里喂鸽子。

senses.en: (technical) not having the same center as something else

example.en: The engineer noticed that the wheel was eccentric and wobbled as it turned.
example.zh: 工程师注意到轮子偏心，转动时会晃动。

senses.en: information or data that is put into a computer or system

example.en: The program needs the user's input before it can start.
example.zh: 程序需要用户的输入才能启动。

senses.en: advice, opinions, or ideas that someone contributes

example.en: We welcome your input on the new project plan.
example.zh: 我们欢迎你对新项目计划提出意见。

senses.en: to put data into a computer

example.en: Please input your password to log in.
example.zh: 请输入密码登录。

senses.en: the science of numbers, quantities, shapes and patterns

example.en: She studies mathematics at university.
example.zh: 她在大学学习数学。

senses.en: a tendency to expect good things to happen; a hopeful attitude

example.en: Her optimism helped the team stay positive during the difficult project.
example.zh: 她的乐观帮助团队在困难的项目中保持积极。

senses.en: old-fashioned; no longer considered modern

example.en: The apartment has dated kitchen cabinets.
example.zh: 这套公寓的橱柜已经过时了。

senses.en: having a date written on it

example.en: He found a letter dated May 12, 1965.
example.zh: 他找到了一封注明日期为1965年5月12日的信。

senses.en: causing feelings of happiness and warmth

example.en: The heartwarming story of the rescued dog went viral.
example.zh: 这只获救小狗的暖心故事在网上疯传。

senses.en: the size or carrying capacity of a ship measured in tons

example.en: The port handles vessels of large tonnage.
example.zh: 这个港口接纳大吨位的船只。

senses.en: (of a disease) able to spread from person to person

example.en: Measles is a highly communicable disease.
example.zh: 麻疹是一种传染性很强的疾病。

senses.en: able to be expressed or conveyed to others

example.en: Fear is a highly communicable emotion in a crowd.
example.zh: 恐惧在人群中是一种极易传染的情绪。

senses.en: a feeling of boredom and lack of interest caused by doing nothing exciting

example.en: A deep ennui settled over her during the long, uneventful summer.
example.zh: 在漫长而平淡的夏天里，她陷入深深的倦怠。

senses.en: the philosophical doctrine that knowledge comes mainly from experience and observation

example.en: Empiricism holds that knowledge is derived from experience.
example.zh: 经验主义认为知识来源于经验。

senses.en: the use of empirical methods in a science or practice
senses.zh: 经验方法的应用；实证方法

example.en: Modern medicine relies on empiricism rather than tradition alone.
example.zh: 现代医学依靠实证方法，而非仅凭传统。

senses.en: a songbird with brownish plumage, such as the song thrush

example.en: A thrush was singing in the garden at dawn.
example.zh: 清晨一只鸫在花园里鸣唱。

senses.en: a fungal infection causing white patches, especially in the mouth of infants

example.en: The baby was treated for oral thrush.
example.zh: 婴儿因鹅口疮接受了治疗。

senses.en: a glaring and ridiculous mistake

example.en: He made a howler by misreading the map.
example.zh: 他看错了地图，犯了个大笑话般的错误。

senses.en: a loud South American monkey

example.en: Howlers are known for their loud calls.
example.zh: 吼猴以响亮的叫声闻名。

senses.en: a short-lived but intense fashion or enthusiasm

example.en: The fitness craze swept the whole city.
example.zh: 健身热潮席卷了整座城市。

senses.en: to develop a network of fine cracks

example.en: The old paint crazed after years in the sun.
example.zh: 旧漆在阳光下暴晒多年后出现了细裂纹。

senses.en: the state or fact of being a father

example.en: He applied for paternity leave after the baby was born.
example.zh: 孩子出生后，他申请了陪产假。

senses.en: descent from a father; the origin of something

example.en: The paternity of the manuscript has been debated for years.
example.zh: 这份手稿的出处多年来一直存在争议。

senses.en: the process of making thread from fibers

example.en: Spinning was traditionally done by hand with a wheel.
example.zh: 纺纱传统上是用纺车手工完成的。

senses.en: the act of turning quickly around a central point

example.en: The skater's fast spinning impressed the judges.
example.zh: 滑冰者快速的旋转给裁判留下了深刻印象。

senses.en: a small open stall or stand where newspapers and magazines are sold

example.en: I bought a magazine at the newsstand near the station.
example.zh: 我在车站附近的报刊亭买了一本杂志。

senses.en: relating to the ornate style of European art, architecture, or music of the 17th and early 18th centuries

example.en: The palace is famous for its baroque architecture.
example.zh: 这座宫殿以其巴洛克式建筑闻名。

senses.en: very elaborately decorated or detailed

example.en: She wore a baroque necklace covered in pearls and gold.
example.zh: 她戴着一条缀满珍珠和黄金的华丽项链。

senses.en: the baroque period or style in art and music
senses.zh: 巴洛克风格，巴洛克时期

example.en: The museum has an excellent collection of Italian baroque.
example.zh: 这家博物馆收藏了大量精美的意大利巴洛克作品。

senses.en: easily offended or upset

example.en: He's touchy about his cooking, so don't criticize it.
example.zh: 他对自己的厨艺很敏感，所以别批评。

senses.en: requiring careful handling; delicate
senses.zh: 棘手的；需要谨慎处理的

example.en: Salary is a touchy issue in most companies.
example.zh: 薪资在大多数公司都是个敏感问题。

senses.en: plural of hen: adult female chickens

example.en: The hens laid plenty of eggs this morning.
example.zh: 母鸡们今天早上下了很多蛋。

senses.en: having many floors or levels

example.en: They built a multistory parking garage downtown.
example.zh: 他们在市中心建了一座多层停车楼。

senses.en: the hard white objects in the mouth used for biting and chewing

example.en: Brush your teeth twice a day.
example.zh: 每天刷两次牙。
